    "Programmatic date setting via setSelectedDates will still update the input as expected.",

    "Verify that focusing the departure input does not change its value.",
    "Verify that pressing Escape after focusing the departure input leaves the value unchanged.",

    "Verify that selecting a date from the date picker updates the input to the locale-specific format (if locale is set) or ISO format (if no locale formatting is configured).",
    "Verify that inline datepickers continue to function correctly."
  ]
